procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
Hearing No. 04 was heard together with hearing No. 06 in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
TUR 57403 was represented by Ege Erdemli.
FRA 57379 was represented by Bertille Postel.
SUI 57071 was represented by Damian Berther. REOPENED HEARING:
Time and date of the decision of the original hearing: 23 July - 16:17
The hearing was reopened on 24-07-2025 as decided in hearing No.15
Hearing No. 04 was heard together with hearing No. 06 in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
FRA 57379 was represented by Bertille Postel.
SUI 57071 was represented by Damian Berther.
TUR 57403 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
Carmen Cameira, helm of POR 57017 gave evidence as a witness.
facts: At the time of the incident, the wind was 15 knots with steep waves of 1,5 metres.
At the starting signal, FRA 57379 was sailing close-hauled on starboard tack four boat lengths from the pin-end mark with no other starboard tack boats between her and the mark.
SUI 57071 was sailing close-hauled on starboard tack two boat lengths astern and to windward of FRA 57379.
TUR 57403 started on a close-hauled course on port tack, one boat length from the pin, with an unidentified Italian boat between her and the pin-end mark.
TUR 57403 was sailing on a converging course bow-to-bow with FRA
When FRA 57379 was half a boat length from TUR 57403, she tacked onto a converging course with SUI 57071, which was sailing at full beating speed in a distance of less than two boat lengths.
If FRA 57379 and SUI 57071 had both held their courses, SUI 57071’s bow would have made contact with the port side of FRA 57379 midships.
At a distance of half a boat length from FRA 57379, SUI 57071 tacked onto port tack.
Fact 6 is changed to: When FRA 57379 was half a boat length from TUR 57403, she tacked onto a converging course with SUI 57071, which was sailing at full beating speed.
Fact 7 is changed to: TUR 57403 tacked to starboard and FRA 57379 continued sailing on port tack for at least four seconds on port tack.
Fact 8 is changed to: At a distance of less than half a boat length between the boats SUI 57071 and FRA 57379 tacked simultaneously.
conclusions: TUR 57403 on port tack failed to keep clear of FRA 57379 on starboard tack and broke RRS 10.
FRA 57379 on port tack failed to keep clear of SUI 57071 on starboard tack and broke RRS 10.
Since FRA 57379 was compelled to break RRS 10 as a consequence of TUR 57403 breaking RRS 10, she is exonerated under RRS 43.1(a) for this breach.
TUR 57403 on port tack failed to keep clear of FRA 57379 on starboard tack and broke RRS 10.
FRA 57379 on port tack failed to keep clear of SUI 57071 on starboard tack and broke RRS 10.
